neighbours.label: The noun that completes an emphatic 'no <noun>' denial of an easy way out (no shortcuts, no excuses, no exceptions, never ... by halves): the thing being categorically ruled out
fire: When it comes to learning a language, there are no shortcuts, only daily practice.
The coach made it clear that he would accept no excuses for missing training.
The rule applies to everyone on the team, and there are no exceptions.
Her grandmother never did anything by halves, least of all a birthday cake.
In this business there are no guarantees, however hard you work.
The surgeon warned that there was no substitute for careful preparation.
The inspector tolerated no half measures when it came to safety.
When he restores an old car there are no compromises on the original parts.
quiet: When it comes to learning a language, there are several shortcuts that daily practice makes easier.
The coach listened to the excuses for missing training and let it go.
The rule applies to most of the team, with a few exceptions for the goalkeepers.
Her grandmother baked half a birthday cake and froze the rest.
In this business the guarantees are written into every contract.
The surgeon said careful preparation was a good substitute for luck.
The inspector suggested a few half measures to save money on safety.
When he restores an old car he makes many compromises on the original parts.

predictions: Sentences that rule something out with 'no shortcuts / no excuses / no exceptions / by halves' reach 0.5-1.0 on that noun. The same nouns affirmed (several shortcuts, the excuses, a few exceptions, half a cake) stay under 0.1.
notes: Probe: 'anything by halves' 1.038, 'no excuses' 0.737, 'no shortcuts' 0.647, 'no third way' 0.310 (adjective between no and noun weakens it), 'unsatisfied with' 0.111, 'Nothing could be done' 0.079; the same nouns affirmed: 'three shortcuts' 0.033, 'accepted the excuses' 0.036, 'half of the book' 0.011, floor 0.014. Card: peaks on ' shortcuts', ' halves', ' third', ' hype', 'uses' (Excuses) after no/never (max 36, layer 20, density 0.12%). The - pole promotes nothing legible; the + pole suppresses ' easy', ' simplistic', ' everything'.
